desc: Implement fast input parsing and special cases K=1 (output A_i) and K=N (output gcd of all elements).
Build freq array over 1..M (M=max(A)) and compute cnt[d] = number of A_j divisible by d using multiple sieve via list slicing.
Compute best[x] = largest divisor d of x with cnt[d]>=K by iterating d from 1 to M ascending and slice-assigning best[d::d]=d.
Output best[A_i] for each i in original order using chunked writes.
Test on sample inputs 1,2,3: all PASSED.
